summary: Project involves generating/updating a report with payment-type-specific date fields.

existing_features.title: Persist mode-specific payment dates in the backend by extending the PaymentEntry model to include optional chequeDate and bankTransferDate fields, and wire these through addPayment and editPayment so the frontend can store the entered dates for Cheque and NEFT/RTGS/UPI payments.

Update the on-screen Reports ledger table to display a single "Payment Date" value that is conditional by payment mode: show bankTransferDate for NEFT/RTGS/UPI payments, show chequeDate for Cheque payments, otherwise fall back to the createdTimestamp date.

Update the exported CSV report to include a "Payment Date" column that is conditional by payment mode: bankTransferDate for NEFT/RTGS/UPI, chequeDate for Cheque, otherwise createdTimestamp; keep other existing export columns unchanged.

new_feature_requests.summary: Update report column logic: show RTGS Date when payment type is RTGS, and Cheque Date when payment type is Cheque.

Add a conditional migration for existing stable data so previously stored PaymentEntry records are upgraded with null chequeDate and null bankTransferDate fields, without changing any existing payment amounts or invoice balances.

projectName: Show mode-specific dates (RTGS date vs Cheque date) in Reports
